high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by Deepika Padukone, featuring a quote from IMDb about her journey in the Indian film industry. The post includes a photograph of Deepika Padukone on the right side, wearing a striped top and a patterned skirt, with her hair styled in loose waves. She is posing confidently with one hand on her hip. The text in the post reads: "When I began my journey, I was often told how a woman must or is expected to navigate her career in order to be successful. However, from the very beginning, I have never been afraid to ask questions, ruffle feathers
